# Fluxline Resonance Group

> Fluxline Resonance Group, LLC (Salt Lake City, Utah) offers consulting, coaching, brand design, web architecture, and identity systems work through The Resonance Core Framework™ — helping founders, leaders, and creatives build congruence between who they are and what they build. Founded by Terence Waters.

The Resonance Core Framework™ (RCF) is a structured identity system built on the principle that sustainable change requires alignment, not force. Developed by Terence Waters through Fluxline, it is delivered through coaching and consulting, explored on The Resonant Identity podcast, and published as a book in Fall 2026.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.fluxline.pro/): Who Fluxline is, core values, and services
- [The Resonance Core Framework™](https://www.fluxline.pro/resonance-core-framework): **The canonical reference for the framework** — what it is, the premise, core concepts, the DRIVE Model, the six core values, who it's for, how to work with it, and FAQ
- [Services](https://www.fluxline.pro/services): Consulting, coaching, brand design, web architecture, personal training, and RCF engagements
- [Books](https://www.fluxline.pro/books): The Resonance Core Framework book and companion workbook
- [RCF Preview (PDF)](https://www.fluxline.pro/scrolls/pdfs/resonance-core-framework-preview-terence-waters.pdf): The book's introduction — why self-help often fails, where the framework came from, and who it's for
- [Contact](https://www.fluxline.pro/contact): Book a free consultation

## Six core values (DII scoring anchors)

Embodied Awareness, Modular Precision, Resilient Alignment, Somatic Discipline, Creative Truth, and Strategic Innovation. These are the scoring anchors of the framework's Decision Integrity Index (DII).
